title: Local SEO playbook 2026: silo structure and service-area pages for a vet clinic
summary: Jacky walks through building a local SEO site for a vet clinic: a silo structure with pillar and sub-service pages, service-area pages for nearby towns, a repeatable location page template, early CRO wins to cut client churn, and Cloudflare hosting.

principles.text: Link every sub-service page back up to its core pillar page so Google sees the silo.
principles.quote: every sub service link back up to this core this core page, right? ... It just kind of communicates to Google like this is your pillar page.

principles.text: Build service-area pages per nearby town and cross-link them to expand your radius beyond what GBP captures.
principles.quote: you're creating around Newark, you should be linking out to another service area page for each location around Newark, right? This helps you expand that radius and capture searches that like your GBP is not going to be able to capture.

principles.text: Unique branded content is the asset nobody can copy.
principles.quote: branded content is your biggest asset when it comes to something that's unique cuz no one can copy that.

principles.text: Front-load the target keyword in the title tag as the first word.
principles.quote: title tag should have um target keyword in the um we like to front-load it. Like it's usually the number like the first word in the title.

principles.text: Do CRO early so leads arrive fast and client churn doesn't hit.
principles.quote: this is how you start getting them leads immediately so churn doesn't hit, you know, 20 to 40% because you're not showing results quick, right?

principles.text: Niche down as an agency instead of being a general marketing consultant.
principles.quote: carve out your niche. Laser focus, I agree. Get it done. Um don't be the general marketing consultant.
